problem.diagnosis: Task registration and binary identity are intact, but the proven bridge loop should refresh heartbeat about every 5 seconds while alive. Current heartbeat is materially stale. Engineering Relay action_selftests does not actively execute the UI Bridge self-test; it only checks hash/task/heartbeat. Current interactive availability is therefore not proven and the bridge is likely not running.

preconditions: installed ui bridge SHA256 equals pinned proven v0.3.4 hash
scheduled task exists with exact expected name
scheduled task principal remains LIMITED and interactive-session scoped
capture pre-repair task state and heartbeat
actions: start or boundedly restart only the exact existing Kevin UI Bridge v0.3 scheduled task
postconditions: new heartbeat timestamp is later than pre-repair heartbeat
heartbeat age is <= 10 seconds when verified
session_id is an interactive logged-in session
ui bridge SHA256 still equals pinned proven hash
typed_repair_contract.rollback: If the task definition or authority changes, restore captured task state. A simple start/restart with unchanged definition requires no code rollback.

monitoring_correction.rule: Do not call UI Bridge healthy from hash_match + task_present alone.
monitoring_correction.relay_action_selftests_limitation: Current v1 action_selftests runs Operator and Initiative -SelfTest but only reports UI Bridge hash/task/heartbeat.

execution_boundary: Do not execute through arbitrary shell or widen Engineering Relay allowlist via a request. Use only an already-proven typed local actuator/maintenance action, or add this as a separately reviewed fixed typed repair verb before local execution.
